request: r7.8 — With a middle-16 square king, prefer knight move proximity to a precage square, then prefer the knight adjacent to the king.
implementation: Keep the existing precage knight-move and Euclidean proximity criteria, then prefer resulting king-knight adjacency. Adjacency applies when White king starts in the middle 16, even when there is no precage target.

method.kind: Exact full-graph cycle analysis after affected-policy refresh
method.reuseProof: Outside-middle-16 starts are unchanged. Within the middle 16, reuse when all old preferred moves already have knight adjacency, or when no geometrically legal king/knight move can achieve adjacency while retaining the unchanged earlier r7 rank. Recompute all other positions, including terminal flags. Earlier rules still filter the same candidates, so these conditions prove the skipped move choices unchanged.

independentVerification.method: Independent root enumeration and iterative Tarjan SCC over saved graph
